specs.Style Name: Amkette Hush Pro Epic M Rechargeable Wireless Mouse

features: Multi-Device Connectivity with Top-Mounted Switch : This wireless bluetooth mouse connects up to 3 devices via 2× Bluetooth 5.2 and 1× USB 2.4GHz and switches between them effortlessly using a conveniently placed top-mounted device switch button for fast, intuitive transitions.

Ergonomic Design with Silent Switches : Thoughtfully designed for comfort and quiet operation, this wireless mouse for laptop and desktop use allows for extended sessions without wrist strain, while silent switches create a completely distraction-free work environment.

Professional-Grade S201 Sensor with Adjustable DPI : The precision S201 optical sensor supports high-accuracy tracking, while the dedicated DPI button lets you customize cursor speed across four levels 800, 1200, 1600, and 3200 for tasks ranging from detailed editing to fast navigation.

Rechargeable Battery with Smart Sleep Technology : The built-in 400mAh wireless mouse rechargeable battery is paired with intelligent sleep technology, extending overall battery life and ensuring the mouse is always ready when you need it most.

LED Battery Indicators for Real-Time Awareness : Stay informed with real-time LED battery level indicators directly on the mouse, so you're never caught off guard by an unexpected power loss during important work sessions.

Multi-Device Connectivity with Dedicated Switch : This wireless bluetooth mouse connects up to 3 devices via 2× Bluetooth 5.2 and 1× USB 2.4GHz and switches between them instantly using a dedicated button, keeping your workflow smooth across your laptop, tablet, and desktop.

Ergonomic Design with Silent Switches : Built for comfort and quiet operation, this wireless mouse for laptop users allows extended use without wrist fatigue, while silent switches ensure a distraction-free environment suited for offices, libraries, and shared workspaces.

Professional-Grade S201 Sensor with Adjustable DPI : The high-precision S201 optical sensor ensures accurate tracking, while the DPI button lets you adjust cursor speed across four levels 800, 1200, 1600, and 2400 tailoring performance to your specific task requirements.

500mAh Rechargeable Battery with Type-C Charging : The built-in 500mAh wireless mouse rechargeable battery charges conveniently via Type-C, delivering reliable power for extended sessions and eliminating the ongoing inconvenience of replacing disposable batteries.

Dual Battery Indicators for Effortless Monitoring : Check remaining battery levels directly on the mouse or on your connected device keeping you informed at all times so you can charge proactively and stay productive without unexpected interruptions.
description: Amkette Hush Pro Epic Rechargeable Wireless Bluetooth Mouse, 3 Device Connectivity with Bluetooth and USB 2.4 GHz, 2400 DPI, Silent Switches, Ergonomic Design, Type-C Charging
